entries.title: Jeremiah 42:1
segments: Then came near all the commanders of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even to the greatest, came near.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:2
segments: And they said to Jeremiah the prophet, Please let our cry be pleasing to you, and pray for us to the LORD your God, even for all this remnant, (for we are left [but] a few of many, as your eyes behold us,)

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:3
segments: that the LORD your God may show us the way in which we may walk, and the thing that we may do.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:4
segments: And Jeremiah the prophet said to them, I have heard. Behold, I will pray to the LORD your God according to your words; and it shall be, all the word the LORD shall answer, I will declare [it] to you. I will keep nothing back from you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:5
segments: And they said to Jeremiah, Let the LORD be a true and faithful witness between us if we do not do even according to all things for which the LORD your God shall send you to us.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:6
segments: Whether [it is] good, or whether it is evil, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, to whom we send you; so that it may be well with us when we obey the voice of the LORD our God.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:7
segments: And it happened after ten days, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:8
segments: And he called Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the commanders of the forces with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:9
segments: And he said to them, So says the LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your cry before Him:

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:10
segments: If you will still remain in this land, then I will build you and will not pull [you] down. And I will plant you and will not pluck [you] up. For I repent of the evil that I have done to you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:11
segments: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Do not be afraid of him, says the LORD. For I [am] with you to save you and to deliver you from his hand.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:12
segments: And I will show mercies to you, so that he may have mercy on you and cause you to return to your own land.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:13
segments: But if you say, We will not dwell in this land, nor obey the voice of the LORD your God,

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:14
segments: saying, No, but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger for bread; and there we will dwell;

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:15
segments: then now hear the word of the LORD, O remnant of Judah. So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: If you surely set your faces to go into Egypt, and go to live there,

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:16
segments: then it will happen, the sword which you feared shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt. And the famine of which you were anxious about shall cling to you there [in] Egypt; and you shall die there.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:17
segments: So [it] shall be to all the men who set their faces to go into Egypt to live there. They shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the plague. And none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring on them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:18
segments: For so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: As My anger and My fury has been poured forth on the people of Jerusalem, so shall My fury be poured forth on you when you shall enter into Egypt. And you shall be a curse, and a wonder, and a shame, and a reproach; and you shall see this place no more.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:19
segments: The LORD has said concerning you, O remnant of Judah, Do not go into Egypt. Know certainly that I have warned you this day.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:20
segments: For you used deceit against your souls when you sent me to the LORD your God, saying, Pray for us to the LORD our God; and according to all that the LORD our God shall say, so declare to us, and we will do [it].

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:21
segments: And I have declared [it] to you today; but you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God, nor anything for which He has sent me to you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 42:22
segments: And therefore know certainly that you shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the plague, in the place where you desire to go to live.
